settings.heading: Size Guide
settings.accent: Find the fit that feels right
settings.text: Sizes vary by brand, style, and fabric. Use the measuring tips below, then contact us about the piece you are considering. Availability varies by item.

settings.title: Bust
settings.text: Around the fullest part, tape level and snug but not tight. Wear the bra you'd wear with the piece.

settings.title: Waist
settings.text: Around your natural waist — the narrowest point, usually just above the belly button. Relax; don't suck in.

settings.title: Hips
settings.text: Measure around the fullest part of your hips and seat, with your feet together.

settings.heading: Find your fit
settings.intro: For item-specific sizing, ask us for the brand’s size chart or garment measurements. Keep the tape level and measure without pulling it tight.
settings.footnote: Not sure? Message us a photo of the tag and your usual size — we'll tell you straight.

settings.heading: How should I choose a swimsuit size?
settings.row_content: Swim sizing varies by brand and cut. Ask about the specific style and check its size guidance before choosing.

settings.heading: How can I check dress or gown length?
settings.row_content: Ask us for the length of the particular style. Consider your height and the shoes you plan to wear.

settings.heading: Is every style available in every size?
settings.row_content: The boutique carries styles from XS to 3X, but the size range and current stock vary by item. Contact us to check.
